requirements.requirement: The system must trigger an Azure Function entry point defined in function_app.py to initiate the CMS Part D ingestion pipeline.
The system must fetch CMS Part D data using a reusable fetcher pattern implemented in data_fetcher_base.py.
The system must successfully download at least one CMS Part D dataset file from the configured source endpoint.
The system must parse raw CMS Part D files into structured records with identifiable prescriber and drug fields.
The system must map each prescriber record to a valid NPI field when present in the source data.
The system must invoke icd10_loader.py to map drug identifiers to a condition taxonomy.
The system must produce normalized prescription metrics (e.g., claim counts, standardized drug identifiers) in a consistent format across all records.
The system must output transformed records in a structure compatible with the PublicHealthData.prescriptions schema defined in PIPE-RX-INGEST-S1.
The system must process a full input file without terminating prematurely under normal conditions.
The system must log ingestion progress and record counts at key stages (fetch, parse, transform).
The system must skip and log records with missing or invalid NPI values without failing the entire pipeline.
The system must assign a null or default taxonomy value when a drug cannot be mapped via the ICD10 loader.
The system must fail the ingestion job with an error state if the CMS data source is unreachable or returns no files.
The system must handle malformed input files by logging the error and continuing processing of remaining valid files.
